creature_deferral_reference_set.derivation: Exact identity/coordinate/heading subset of the recovered Multiversal_8E-008G-R1_Formally_Deferred_Source_Candidate_Register.csv; rows where proposed_content_class == creature.

experience_contract.meaning: Source-accounted candidate with no verified canonical binding or approved exclusion; available to authorized provenance/source-recovery views but not presented as a canonical Creature/NPC Definition.
experience_contract.library_default: Exclude from canonical Creature/NPC browse results unless the current surface explicitly includes source-recovery/deferred candidates.
experience_contract.inspector_behavior: Show source coordinates, heading text, candidate identity, R1 disposition, and public-canon status; do not synthesize a stat block, stable Definition identity, CR, ecology, relationships, or mechanics absent separate governed evidence.
experience_contract.compare_behavior: May compare source candidate evidence to an authorized canonical or draft target only as provenance/recovery analysis; candidate status never becomes identity equivalence.
experience_contract.authoring_behavior: GM/Creator may open the source candidate as recovery/reference evidence. Converting it into a Campaign-local draft or future canonical proposal requires a separate owning workflow and explicit provenance receipt.
experience_contract.scene_encounter_behavior: A formally deferred source candidate cannot be quick-added or launched as a Creature/NPC participant until a governed usable Definition or Campaign-local authored object exists.
experience_contract.privacy_behavior: Candidate existence, source coordinates, counts, headings, and recovery metadata are permission-filtered before serialization and derived counts/facets.
experience_contract.public_canon_behavior: Formal deferral is neither canonical promotion nor exclusion. Public-canon completion requires an explicit later convert/bind/exclude/supersede/waive disposition.

acceptance_mapping.reason: Heading/display-name similarity cannot create identity or automatic merge.
Deferred candidate existence and derived counts are authorization-filtered before serialization.
Authorized provenance views must distinguish formal deferral from source fact, recommendation, conflict, and canonical Definition state.
Incomplete/deferred source evidence remains inspectable without fabricated replacement Creature fields.
